g.text: Spec 001 controller · Spec 002 agent · Spec 003 on-call UI
(deployed on cf1z; cloud-agnostic — EKS / Azure kubeadm)
Numbered edges trace the end-to-end flow: ① detect → ⑬ reclaim.
End-to-end flow (read edges in this order) ===
NPD plugin flips a NodeCondition + writes Event
Agent loop: tool calls (Bash · NR MCP · SDK built-ins)
Tools read from worker / NR (read-only credentials)
Controller's reconciler runs the confidence gate
Block Kit Slack post (Applied / HumanInLoop / Critical)
Engineer port-forwards + opens per-case page in UI
UI patches Node + appends ui-action-history annotation
MLC reclaims VM on its next reconcile (existing primitive)
Agent tool surface (READ-ONLY by credential design)
Spend bounded by API key budget;
Action audit lives on the NHD CR's
